title: System stalker
description: This mod adds several entities to your game
body:
## This mod requires [Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)

### System Stalker

With this mod, you'll constantly feel someone's presence in your world. Every new entity will make you feel uncomfortable.

## About mod:
- This mod adds 5 different entities. Each of them has a different behavior and personality. No one knows what they will do next time..
- Every entity is like a living thing. Movements and emotions.
- The element of surprise. The entities will be watching you at the most unexpected moments and will scare you with their presence.

This mod is still in development, and new content will be added soon. If you find a bug, please report it on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/UHMqcFpXwr).
